doc.title: Zeke Mullins interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 9, 2017

title: The best years for work
summary: He recalls busy times with plenty of work, especially in warm weather.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Did you have a favorite span of years in your life where things were good at home, your work was good, the country seemed to be not in crisis.

Yeah, yeah. I know what you mean. I’ve gone through that, yeah. Work was just coming in, sometimes you have to turn some people down and say I’ll catch you next round you know. Yeah. But I don’t know, music is like that. Just like that. Sometimes you come to where everybody’s coming out, especially in the warm weather, coming out and they want to go to night clubs and dance. Yeah.
